description: This Java class is a Spring configuration class that defines beans related to template services within the Apache Fineract project. It provides bean definitions for 'TemplateDomainService' and 'TemplateMergeService', conditionally initializing them if they are missing, and injects required dependencies.

classes.name: TemplateConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class providing bean definitions for template-related services with conditional instantiation.

methods.name: templateDomainService
methods.description: Defines a bean for TemplateDomainService, initializing it with JpaTemplateDomainService if not already present.

methods.name: templateMergeService
methods.description: Defines a bean for TemplateMergeService, initializing it with FineractProperties if not already present.
